package.name: linked-web-apis
package.author: Milan Dojchinovski
package.notes: The Linked Web APIs dataset is the first and the largest RDF dataset with semantic descriptions about Web APIs. In total the datasets contain over half million of RDF triples. It contains information about Web APIs, mashups and developers. It captures the provenance, temporal, technical, functional, and non-functional aspects. The dataset conforms to the Linked Data principles. It contains owl:sameAs links to four central LOD datasets: DBpedia, Freebase, GeoNames and LinkedGeoData. For more information check the homepage of the dataset: http://linked-web-apis.fit.cvut.cz/
package.title: Linked Web APIs dataset
